conclusions.label: initial
conclusions.hypothesis: The SQL injection attack on SRV-WEB-04 succeeded: the attacker exploited a vulnerable MySQL 5.7.25 instance (inside CVE-2023-21980's range) to execute UNION SELECT queries and exfiltrate 1.7 MB of data including user credentials and portal user records.
conclusions.sufficiency: The evidence is sufficient to classify the attack as SUCCEEDED. Four factors converge: the host was vulnerable (version_in_range), the attack executed on the host (logs_consistent), data was exfiltrated (exfil_indicators), and a related alert corroborates the attack pattern. The server logs show the UNION SELECT injection query executed successfully and returned 38,402 rows from portal_users. Packet metadata confirms 1.7 MB of high-entropy data was sent to the attacker IP with exfil indicators flagged. No controls (WAF disabled, broad DB grants) prevented exploitation. The host was not patched against CVE-2023-21980 (running 5.7.25, fixed in 5.7.30).
